data.name: Camouflage Bomb
data.description: An alchemical sapper becomes skilled at hiding his bombs. When deploying a delayed bomb or trip mine, the alchemical sapper can camouflage the bomb by taking an additional full-round action. Creatures searching for traps must succeed at a Perception check (DC %1) to notice a camouflaged bomb.|10+AlchemistLVL+INT
